endings.delivered: The medicine and replacement wick arrive intact. Nara’s exchange and any return promise are entered in the journal.
endings.urgent: Station rescuers receive the medicine and wick under urgent conditions. The exchange obligations remain.
endings.evacuated: The wagon is abandoned. The salvage choice and earlier promises are recorded; delivery fails.

scenes.title: Nara’s Medicine Ledger
scenes.text: Nara must supply residents as well as your station. Each player holds a different documented constraint. Share them and compare three offers. There is no unrestricted bargaining engine: agree on one posted exchange.
scenes.practice: Everyone chooses on their own phone. Choices can change until closure. Ready does not apply effects. Plain speech is enough; acting is optional.

options.title: Buy the sealed medicine
options.consequence: Spend 3 Supplies; keep the bell and make no promise.

options.title: Exchange the bell and one Supply
options.consequence: Spend 1 Supply and the bell. Gain medicine and ferry trust.

options.title: Accept a documented return journey
options.consequence: Gain medicine without spending Supplies; gain 1 Alarm and record a return promise.

cards.text: Nara will release the essential medicine through any one of the three posted offers.
The station needs sealed medicine; opening the package is not a valid offer.
The decorative bell can serve the ferry as a warning signal.
Trading the bell improves ferry trust but removes the crew’s memento.
Paying three Supplies creates no future obligation.
A documented return journey costs time now: one Alarm.
No offer grants an additional storm shield voucher.
The coming storm needs at least two powered rounds; preserving Supplies may help protection.

scenes.title: The Three Mist Bridges
scenes.text: Three crossings emerge from the mist. Each crew member holds one authenticated fact. Share your cards, combine load, availability and destination, then each vote for a bridge. Two wrong submissions cost one Alarm each; then the route is explained.
scenes.practice: Practice: a bridge can carry your load and still lead to the wrong gate. Each person shares a fact, then votes independently.

options.title: North
options.consequence: A wrong bridge adds one Alarm. A correct solution needs no roll.

options.title: Middle
options.consequence: A wrong bridge adds one Alarm. A correct solution needs no roll.

options.title: South
options.consequence: A wrong bridge adds one Alarm. A correct solution needs no roll.

cards.text: The vehicle weighs six. Essential cargo is already included and cannot be discarded.
Taking the family aboard adds one unit of weight.
North supports eight and leads through Sun.
Middle supports ten and leads through Moon.
South supports seven and leads through Leaf.

hints: Compare the required destination with each gate.
The destination is beyond Sun; which bridge leads there?
North is open and supports eight: enough for either passenger load.

scenes.title: The Loaded Causeway
scenes.text: The medicine is sealed in the wagon. The correct bridge still needs a crossing plan.
scenes.practice: Everyone chooses on their own phone. Choices can change until closure. Ready does not apply effects. Plain speech is enough; acting is optional.

options.title: Brace the causeway
options.consequence: Spend 2 Supplies; one Engineer may reduce the cost to 1.

options.title: Risk the span — DC 13
options.consequence: Pledge up to four Effort; failure loses 2 Integrity.

scenes.title: Orin’s Workshop
scenes.text: Orin can restore one Integrity before the storm. Your chosen medicine exchange remains recorded in the season journal.
scenes.practice: Everyone chooses on their own phone. Choices can change until closure. Ready does not apply effects. Plain speech is enough; acting is optional.

options.title: Buy one hull repair
options.consequence: Spend 3 Supplies (2 with Engineer), restore 1 Integrity.

scenes.title: The Living Mist
scenes.text: Three rounds: Pathfinder is threatened first, Mechanics second, both third. Two Shields protect a threatened squad; Mechanics needs three in round two if the family is aboard. Three Supply actions earn one Supply and a power round. Three Repel remove one Alarm. Achieve two power rounds to avoid late delivery. Missing actions are Shield in your own squad.
scenes.practice: Practice for one minute: eight actions must cover protection and power. Two Pathfinder Shield + three Supply + three Repel works in round one. Private arrangements never replace these actions.

scenes.title: The Medicine Lantern
scenes.text: Keep the medicine promise and the station’s lantern lit.
scenes.practice: Everyone chooses on their own phone. Choices can change until closure. Ready does not apply effects. Plain speech is enough; acting is optional.
